replay.guide_command: PYTHONPATH=<pinned-esso-root> python3 -m ESSO guide --input src/kernels/dex/proof_market_procurement_v2.yaml --goal verify --profile audit

proved_in_declared_model: buyer value conserves across escrow, seller payment, direct-execution payment, and refund
seller bond conserves across escrow, full prover-fault restitution, and non-fault return
proof reserve conserves across remaining and paid reserve units
owner-epoch reserve cap conserves across remaining and paid cap units
reserve and owner-epoch debits match for every modeled reserve payment
a no-acceptance transition cannot ratchet the posted price
seller payment requires a verified witness, one occurrence-payment claim, and one settlement commit
direct-execution payment requires the DIRECT lane, a direct-execution witness, one occurrence-payment claim, and one settlement commit
selected seller payment never exceeds the fixed posted price
a positive reserve payment requires an eligible verified work claim and a fresh economic work key
a verifier-created occurrence-bound prover-fault witness is required before the modeled bond is fully slashed and direct fallback is selected
verifier infrastructure fault returns the full modeled bond before direct fallback
prover-fault and verifier-fault records are mutually exclusive
a prover-fault witness, a verified-validity witness, and seller payment cannot coexist in the modeled lifecycle

counterexamples.witness: JOB_DirectPending with a non-DIRECT lane could commit a three-unit direct payment and violate the lane-bound payment invariant
an assigned or submitted prover could be fully slashed while prover_fault_witness_units remained zero
counterexamples.repair: record_prover_fault_and_select_direct requires a verifier-created occurrence-bound fault witness

counterexamples.witness: JOB_ProverFaultWitnessed with one prover-fault witness could transition to JOB_Verified and create a verified-validity witness for the same occurrence
counterexamples.repair: exclusive adjudication typestate plus reciprocal witness, claim, and settlement guards

nonclaims: The one-job integer-unit state machine is not a live price, cost, demand, identity, latency, throughput, or equilibrium model.
The one-bit economic-work-key state models exact single-occurrence consumption; it does not prove canonical key encoding or semantic-equivalence deduplication.
Direct execution availability and funding are premises; the model proves no infrastructure liveness.
The result does not prove cryptography, canonical codecs, beneficial ownership, failure-domain independence, durability, concurrency, consensus, runtime refinement, or no-bypass mounting.
The result grants no listing, assignment, proof-admission, payment, slash, token, settlement, finality, release, or production authority.
